03

Cap Interface

Patch-note cap display

The April 3 PTR changelog added Cap Attack Speed to the Combat section in the Character window. It shows the real cap with modifiers applied. The same changelog fixed stat updating after increase, decrease, and reset, and fixed Cap Attack Speed rounding under the Vocation section.

04

Cap Sources

Where caps can come from
SourceConfirmed Example
Talent TreeGeneric notable can increase Attack Speed cap by +1 attack per second and Cooldown Reduction cap by +10%.
Soul ShardsAttack Speed cap and Resistance cap are listed Soul Shard bonuses.
Vocation NotablesSome vocation notables modify Attack Speed cap or role caps.
